description: Lists tasks in one list: id, title, notes, status (needsAction|completed), due (date only — the API never stores a time of day), completed timestamp, parent (subtask's parent id), position (opaque sort key within siblings — sort by it client-side; change it only via move_task), updated, deleted/hidden flags, webViewLink. IMPORTANT: tasks completed in Google's own apps are also flagged hidden — pass show_completed=true AND show_hidden=true to reliably see all completed tasks. For incremental sync poll with updated_min plus show_deleted=true and show_hidden=true, so deletions and clears are not missed (the API has no push notifications). due_min/due_max bound the due date; completed_min/completed_max the completion time. Paginate with page_token; page_size caps at 100 (API default 20). Filtering by due/completed dates implies those fields exist — tasks without a due date never match due bounds.

completed_max.description: Upper bound on the completion date (RFC3339).

completed_min.description: Lower bound on the completion date (RFC3339).

due_max.description: Upper bound on the due date (RFC3339).

due_min.description: Lower bound on the due date (RFC3339).

page_size.description: Max tasks per page (1..100; the API's default is 20).

show_assigned.description: Include tasks assigned to the user from Google Docs / Chat spaces (API default false).

show_completed.description: Include completed tasks (API default true; needs show_hidden=true to catch tasks completed in Google's UI).

show_deleted.description: Include deleted tasks (API default false; for sync).

tasklist_id.description: The task list id — from list_tasklists or create_tasklist output. "@default" addresses the user's default list.

updated_min.description: Only tasks modified after this RFC3339 UTC timestamp (updatedMin) — the sync filter.

name: list_tasks
title: List tasks
